hero.lede: Shooting, CQB, TCCC, timer sessions, and ballistic calculations in one place. Every log grows a region in your Operator Brain; neglected skills visibly fade. NÖRO tells you what to do next.

how.title: Log it. Grow it. Don't let it fade.

1.label: 01 · LOG
1.title: Enter your training
1.body: Shooting strings, CQB drills, TCCC assessments, timer or dry-fire sessions. Log the work — the system handles the rest.

2.label: 02 · GROW
2.title: Your brain levels up
2.body: Each entry scores the relevant regions. Higher scores mean more growth. Neurons connect as regions level and neighbors link up.

3.label: 03 · PROTECT
3.title: Keep skills alive
3.body: Regions you neglect fade slowly, based on skill-decay research. NÖRO nudges you when it's time to refresh.

brain.lede: Each region maps to modules by real brain function. One activity can feed multiple regions: CQB grows movement, spatial awareness, and decision-making together.

1.html: Levels per region. Early levels come fast; the summit takes consistent work.

2.html: Decay floor. Even after a break you won't drop below 40% of your peak. Return visits earn 1.5× points.

3.html: Day thresholds. Knowledge fades faster than reflexes. Each region has its own timer.

noro.titleHtml:
A coach at your side.
With a sense of humor.
noro.lede: After every log, NÖRO explains what's growing and what's fading. Stuck on the UI? Ask how the site works. Drag the panel anywhere on screen.
noro.name: NÖRO

1.title: Post-log debrief
1.body: Score breakdown, commentary, level-ups, and streak tracking.

2.title: AAR helper
2.body: Two-question after-action review. Reminds you on the next log.

3.title: Site guide
3.body: Ask "How do I save a ballistic profile?" — step-by-step help and navigation.

lines.0: Trigger finger's warm! Shooting log hit Motor cortex +34. Score 92% — with grouping like that you'd thread a coin slot.
lines.1: Side effects: Cerebellum +5, Occipital lobe +5. Meanwhile Brain stem has been quiet 26 days — fade starts in 4.
lines.2: How do I save a ballistic profile?
lines.3:
In Ballistics Terminal enter bullet and weapon data, set distance and wind, then tap "Save profile". Parietal lobe scores too.
Go to page →

1.title: Only you can see it
1.body: Your brain map, logs, and NÖRO chats are private. Instructors can't view your brain.

2.title: No operational details
2.body: NÖRO blocks messages with location, coordinates, plates, or mission specifics.

3.title: Use a callsign
3.body: No real name, rank, or unit required. Operate under a callsign.

final.title: Wake your brain today.
